# Perfect Sweep

> Free basketball World Cup fantasy game: roll national squads, draft your dream five, and win the Cup undefeated in the browser.

Perfect Sweep is an independent, free basketball draft game at https://perfectsweep.app/. It is a basketball fantasy game built around legendary FIBA World Cup national teams (1986–2023). No account, no download, no paywall — it runs as a browser basketball game.

Not affiliated with FIBA.

## Play

- [Play Perfect Sweep](https://perfectsweep.app/): Tip off a casual run. Roll a historic national squad, sign one player per position (PG / SG / SF / PF / C), pick a tactic (Run & Gun, Balanced, or Lockdown), and simulate an 8-game World Cup (group stage → 2nd round → quarterfinal → semifinal → final).
- [How to play](https://perfectsweep.app/?howto): Roll national squads → draft your dream five → win the Cup undefeated. Two swaps per run (nation or year). Win the Final = World Champions. 8–0 = Perfect Sweep, which unlocks a bonus game vs the 1992 Dream Team.
- [Daily Challenge](https://perfectsweep.app/?daily): One shared draw per UTC day. Post a nickname and compare efficiency on that day's board.
- [Teams archive](https://perfectsweep.app/?teams): Browse nations, World Cup squads, ratings, and gameplay traits.
- [Hall of Fame](https://perfectsweep.app/?leaderboard): Reserved for Perfect Sweep + Dream Team winners, ranked by total margin.
- [About](https://perfectsweep.app/?about): The idea, the archive, and how players are rated.
